summary: Names for building a horse's look with horse.setLook: `body` is the coat, `head` the breed, `hair` the mane, and `tail` the tail. The server chooses the look, so all players see the same horse. A horse with no look given gets a random common one.

options.summary: All the game's names for one part.

common.summary: The common names for one part, which random looks are chosen from.
common.exampleLua:
local coats = kcds.characters.HorseLooks.common("body")
horse:setLook({ body = coats[1] })
common.exampleCs:
var coats = HorseLooks.Common("body");
horse.SetLook(new { body = coats[0] });
